picks.title: An entanglement band structure for general multiqubit states
picks.why_zh: 把多比特纠缠不变量写成球面上的非厄米本征值“能带”，无增益/损耗即可出现例外点；绕 EP 交换两带形成黎曼面，五比特时可有限歧义地标定纠缠类——纠缠 × 非厄米拓扑。
picks.summary_zh: Majorana 曾用 Bloch 球上的点刻画对称多比特态。本文对一般态只投影一个比特，其余子系统的纠缠不变量成为方向依赖的非厄米矩阵本征值，并在球面上形成“纠缠能带”。例外点在无增益/损耗处出现，标志其余子系统纠缠族的切换；环绕 EP 使两带交换，故能带组成单一黎曼面。在五比特情形，该结构可在有限歧义内固定纠缠类。工作把纠缠分类与非厄米能带/例外点语言直接对接。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: Majorana drew a symmetric multiqubit state as points on the Bloch sphere, antipodal to the zeros of its overlap with spin coherent states. Projecting only one qubit of a general state leaves the others in a state that varies with direction. Its entanglement invariants are eigenvalues of a non-Hermitian matrix and form bands over the sphere. Exceptional points appear, without gain or loss, where the entanglement family of the rest changes. Circling one exchanges two bands, so the bands form one Riemann surface. At five qubits it fixes the entanglement class up to finitely many choices.

picks.title: Boundary exceptional point driven chiral switch of topological edge states
picks.why_zh: 有限 SSH 链两端局域非厄米势诱导边界例外点，解析给出 Γ_EP；动力学环绕可实现手性、近乎完美保真度的拓扑边态对端转移，且不扰动体带——非厄米 × 拓扑边态操控。
picks.summary_zh: 作者研究两端带增益/损耗的有限 SSH 链：利用有限尺寸下两条 mid-gap 边态杂化，解析得到边界诱导例外点坐标 Γ_EP=±i v^N/w^{N-1}，此处边态合并。动力学环绕边界 EP 可实现鲁棒手性边态转移：依环绕取向，一端局域边态或以近乎完美保真度转到对端，或经双切换回到起点。非厄米性严格限于边界，故手性输运不改体带谱。框架最小、可实验检验，适合边界驱动的大规模拓扑手性开关。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: We theoretically investigate the interplay of topology and localized non-Hermiticity in a finite Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain characterized by non-Hermitian potentials at its boundaries. By tuning the boundary gain and loss parameters, we exploit the finite-size hybridization of two mid-gap topological edge states to analytically derive the exact coordinates of boundary-induced exceptional points (EPs), $\Gamma_{\rm EP}=\pm i v^{N}/w^{N-1}$, at which these states undergo coalescence. We demonstrate that dynamically encircling these boundary EPs facilitates a robust, chiral edge state-transfer protocol. Depending on the orientation of the encircling loop, this protocol allows a topological edge state localized at one boundary to be either transferred to the opposite edge with perfect fidelity or returned to its starting position through a double switching process. Importantly, since the non-Hermiticity remains strictly confined to the boundaries, this chiral transport occurs without affecting the energy spectrum of the bulk bands. These results establish a minimal framework for a large-scale topological chiral switch that is experimentally verifiable and capable of being controlled through boundary non-Hermitian driving.

picks.title: Quantics tensor trains for multiloop functional renormalization group in multiorbital impurity models
picks.why_zh: 把多圈 fRG 直接写在 quantics 张量列车上，保留三独立顶点频率且免显式高频参数化；并在补偿交错磁环境下展示轨道劈裂诱导的局域自旋响应——张量网络 × 强关联 × altermagnetism。
picks.summary_zh: 多轨道杂质的全频率相互作用数值昂贵。作者将多圈函数重整化群直接置于 quantics 张量列车表示，在宽频率范围保留三个独立顶点频率，无需显式高频参数化；解析张量算子完成频率变换与内求和，避免稠密顶点中间量。多圈修正改善与独立参考的顶点/响应符合，并复现低能 NRG 自能。低温计算分辨解析延拓散射率的二次频率贡献。简并双轨道杂质在固定 Hund 耦合下呈现不同自旋/轨道/电荷响应；在补偿交错磁环境中，轨道能级劈裂即使未扰杂质磁化为零也可诱导局域自旋响应，增大 Hund 抑制轨道响应却增强自旋极化——单粒子重整化传播无法复现该强极化依赖。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: The full frequency dependence of electronic interactions is central to dynamical correlations, but its numerical cost restricts multiorbital calculations. We formulate the multiloop functional renormalization group directly in the quantics tensor train representation, retaining all three independent vertex frequencies over broad ranges without an explicit high-frequency parametrization. Analytical tensor operators perform frequency transformations and internal summations without dense vertex intermediates. Multiloop corrections improve agreement of vertices and responses with independent references and reproduce the low-energy numerical renormalization group self-energy. Lower-temperature calculations resolve a quadratic frequency contribution to the analytically continued scattering rate. A degenerate two-orbital impurity exhibits distinct spin, orbital, and charge responses at fixed Hund coupling. In a compensated altermagnetic environment, an orbital-level splitting induces a local spin response despite zero magnetization of the unperturbed impurity. Increasing Hund coupling suppresses the orbital response while increasing its spin polarization. Renormalized one-particle propagation alone does not reproduce this strong polarization dependence. These results extend compressed multiloop calculations to dynamical correlations in multiorbital environments.

picks.title: Ubiquitous topological materials protected by hidden partial symmetries
picks.authors: Lumen Eek · Xuelong Chen · Malte Röntgen · Wenlong Gao 等
picks.authors_full: Lumen Eek , Xuelong Chen , Malte Röntgen , Wenlong Gao , Cristiane Morais Smith
picks.why_zh: 提出“部分潜伏对称”：只需在有效哈密顿量某些能标近似成立即可保护近似量子化拓扑与稳健边态，并实验实现厄米/非厄米弱对称 SSH、BBH 样模型——拓扑保护条件的弱化 × 非厄米。
picks.summary_zh: 传统拓扑相要求对称性在整个系统成立。作者引入 partial latent symmetries：只需在有效哈密顿量的特定能标近似不变。据此构造 SSH 与 Benalcazar–Bernevig–Hughes 的弱对称版本：行为类似常规对应物并承载稳健边态，但拓扑不变量仅近似量子化。文末实验实现厄米与非厄米近似拓扑绝缘体并探测边态。工作提示可用弱对称要求替代强对称约束，拓宽可实现拓扑材料范围。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: Symmetries play a crucial role in protecting the topological phases of insulators, ensuring the robustness of their surface states against perturbations. Traditionally, these symmetries have to be obeyed by the system as a whole, which is a rather strong constraint. In this work, we demonstrate that topological effects can also be realized through a substantially weaker form of symmetry that we coin \emph{partial latent symmetries}. For these, invariance is required only at certain energy scales of an effective Hamiltonian, rather than for the object as a whole. Applying this idea, we construct weak-symmetry versions of the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger and Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes models. These weak-symmetry models behave in many aspects just like their conventional brethren---in particular, they host robust edge states---, though the corresponding topological invariants are only \emph{approximately} quantized. We conclude this work by experimentally realizing Hermitian and non-Hermitian versions of such approximate topological insulators and probe their edge states. Overall, given the ubiquity of symmetry in all areas of physics and engineering, we foresee our work to serve as a cornerstone for exploring how conventional, strong symmetry requirements can be replaced by weak-symmetry ones.

picks.title: Chirality, Klein duality, and the stability of Kitaev spin liquids on the star lattice
picks.why_zh: 星格点 Yao–Kivelson 手性 Kitaev 自旋液体的 PSG 与 Klein 对偶分析：自旋–规范锁定下必须破时间反演；并解释 AF 相对 FM Kitaev 侧 Heisenberg 扰动稳定窗口窄得多——Kitaev/任意子序 × 拓扑自旋液体。
picks.summary_zh: 星格点承载 Yao–Kivelson 手性自旋液体，恰可解 Kitaev 点依耦合比可为非阿贝尔或阿贝尔。先前 DMRG 显示加 Heisenberg 后 FM Kitaev 稳定窗宽、AF 侧极窄。作者用费米部分子投影对称群证明：只要 π 自旋转动对部分子作用与精确解相同（自旋–规范锁定），时间反演对称平均场在任意程三角形上振幅为零，故该格点上 Kitaev 型自旋液体必须破时间反演。两种符号的阿贝尔/非阿贝尔液体共享同一手性 PSG，其间转变是能带反转。Klein 对偶反转 Heisenberg 并置换 PSG，锁定类不变；映到自身的 Z₂ 自旋液体相若连通则含 Kitaev 点。关于 Kitaev 点的二阶微扰定位不对称：三角形响应两边相同，而三角形间键上两非对角 Heisenberg 项产生相同四 vison 并在 AF 侧相长、FM 侧近相消，使低能四 vison 在 AF 侧混入强约 82 倍。另分类 352 个含自旋轨道振幅的 Z₂ PSG。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: The star lattice hosts the Yao-Kivelson chiral spin liquid, an exactly solvable Kitaev spin liquid that breaks time reversal spontaneously and is non-Abelian or Abelian depending on the ratio of its two couplings. A density-matrix renormalization group study found that an added Heisenberg exchange leaves it a wide stability window for ferromagnetic but only a narrow one for antiferromagnetic Kitaev coupling. Using projective symmetry groups (PSGs) of fermionic partons, we show that the chirality is not a peculiarity of the solvable point: whenever the $\pi$ spin rotations act on the partons as in the exact solution (spin-gauge locking), a time-reversal-symmetric mean-field state has no amplitude on the triangles, at any range, so a Kitaev-type spin liquid on this lattice must break time reversal. The Abelian and non-Abelian liquids of both signs share a single chiral PSG, within which their transition is a band inversion. The Klein duality, which reverses the Heisenberg coupling, permutes the PSGs and leaves exactly the locked ones unchanged; a $Z_2$ spin-liquid phase mapped onto itself is therefore locked and, if it spans a connected range of couplings, contains a Kitaev point. Unprojected mean-field theory in Kitaev's Majorana representation treats both signs alike. Exact second-order perturbation theory about the Kitaev points locates the asymmetry: the triangles respond identically for both signs, whereas on the bonds between triangles the two off-diagonal Heisenberg terms create the same four visons and interfere constructively for antiferromagnetic and almost destructively for ferromagnetic coupling, admixing a low-energy four-vison state $82$ times more strongly on the antiferromagnetic side. The PSG results rest on a classification of $352$ $Z_2$ PSGs with spin-orbit-coupled amplitudes, which also identifies the fermionic partners of the known Schwinger-boson spin liquids.

picks.title: Theory of the intrinsic optical anomalous Hall responses in time-reversal symmetry breaking superconductors
picks.subjects: Superconductivity (cond-mat.supr-con) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas)
picks.why_zh: 统一处理破时间反演多带超导体的本征光学反常霍尔：证明其为量子几何效应，厘清幺正/非幺正配对方、带间配对与 SOC 的必要条件——拓扑超导 × Berry/量子几何 × 自旋霍尔类响应。
picks.summary_zh: 破时间反演（含拓扑 p_x+ip_y）超导期望光学反常霍尔，但干净极限微观要件未清。作者对具空间反演的 TRSB 多带超导建立统一理论，把本征光学霍尔确立为量子几何现象。区分幺正与非幺正 TRSB；图示两类过程——单电子隧穿与库珀对隧穿——皆至少含一次由带间速度（关联带间 Berry 联络）驱动的带间隧穿。严格证明：幺正态要产生本征霍尔必须有带间配对；非幺正态则非绝对必要，仅带内配对也可经单电子隧穿产生霍尔（需 SOC）。积出空穴自由度的有效理论复现上述结论，并说明配对如何赋予电子有效 Berry 曲率。对称分析还表明：近超导能隙边的本征共振在非幺正态允许、在幺正态禁戒，可作配对候选鉴别指南。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: Determining the symmetry of the Cooper pairing in superconductors is a central challenge in condensed matter physics. Time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) is among the most distinctive symmetry-breaking pattern of a superconductor. An important subset of TRSB pairing states, including the topological $p_x+ip_y$ pairing, is expected to exhibit the optical anomalous Hall effect. However, the microscopic ingredients that enable the Hall response and their underlying organizing principle in clean superconductors remain unelucidated. Here, we develop a unified theory for TRSB multiband superconductors possessing inversion symmetry, and establish their intrinsic optical Hall response as fundamentally a quantum-geometric phenomenon. We distinguish unitary and nonunitary TRSB states. Diagrammatically, we identify two classes of processes: single-electron tunneling and Cooper-pair tunneling. Both involve at least one interband tunneling event driven by the interband velocity-which is closely tied to the interband Berry connection. We rigorously prove that interband pairing is a prerequisite for unitary states to generate intrinsic Hall response, whereas it is not absolutely needed for nonunitary states. In nonunitary states with intraband pairing alone, the Hall effect can arise through single-electron tunneling, provided spin-orbit coupling is present. An effective theory obtained by integrating out the hole degrees of freedom reproduces these results and shows how pairing may endow electrons with effective Berry curvature. Finally, through symmetry analysis, we show that intrinsic resonances near the superconducting gap edge are allowed in nonunitary states but forbidden in unitary states. Our work thus establishes quantum geometry as a unifying principle for the intrinsic Hall response in superconductors and provides a guide for distinguishing different candidate TRSB pairings.

picks.title: Electric-field tunable spin texture in dual-gated HfS$_2$/graphene van der Waals heterostructures
picks.authors: Haozhe Yang · Zhendong Chi · Eoin Dolan · Josep Ingla-Aynés 等
picks.authors_full: Haozhe Yang , Zhendong Chi , Eoin Dolan , Josep Ingla-Aynés , Beatriz Martín-García , Witold Skowroński , Marco Gobbi , Andrey Chuvilin , Luis E. Hueso , Fèlix Casanova
picks.why_zh: 双栅 HfS₂/石墨烯异质结实验：垂直电场重组有效自旋织构，把自旋–电荷转换从出平面自旋霍尔主导调到含 Rashba–Edelstein 面内分量——自旋轨道 × 自旋电子学电控。
picks.summary_zh: 自旋–电荷转换可含多种自旋极化方向分量，反映底层自旋织构。石墨烯范德华异质结界面 SOC 可托管多通道。作者在双栅 HfS₂/石墨烯中独立调控载流子密度与垂直电场，以区分静电掺杂与电场诱导自旋轨道效应。非局域自旋进动显示：近零垂直场时转换以出平面自旋的自旋霍尔分量为主；增大垂直场增强 Rashba–Edelstein 型面内自旋分量（含平行与垂直于电流方向）。实验证据表明垂直电场可重构有效自旋织构并调控各转换分量，实现自旋轨道功能的电学可调。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: Spin-charge interconversion provides the essential link between spin information and electrical signals in spintronic devices. In spin-orbit coupled systems, spin-charge interconversion can contain multiple components associated with different spin-polarization directions, reflecting the underlying spin texture. Tuning this spin texture therefore provides a way to control not only the magnitude of spin-charge interconversion, but also the balance among its different components. Graphene-based van der Waals heterostructures provide an attractive platform for this purpose because interfacial spin-orbit coupling can host multiple spin-charge interconversion channels that couple to different spin-polarization directions. Here, we demonstrate electric-field control of spin texture in a dual-gated HfS$_2$/graphene van der Waals heterostructure, where independent control of carrier density and vertical electric field allows us to disentangle electrostatic doping from electric field-induced spin-orbit effects. Nonlocal spin precession measurements show that near zero vertical electric field, spin-charge interconversion is dominated by a spin Hall component with out-of-plane spins. Increasing the vertical electric field enhances additional in-plane spin components with Rashba-Edelstein-like character, including both parallel and perpendicular to the charge current contributions. These results provide experimental evidence that a vertical electric field can reconfigure the effective spin texture and control the corresponding spin-charge interconversion components, demonstrating electrical tunability of spin-orbit functionalities.

picks.title: Two quantum skyrmions form a magnon Josephson junction
picks.subjects: Other Condensed Matter (cond-mat.other) ; Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el)
picks.why_zh: 阻挫自旋-1/2 磁体中两个量子斯格明子束缚成“分子”，相对螺旋度与转移磁子数构成磁子约瑟夫森结 H=E_C n²−W cosθ——斯格明子 × 磁子相干/量子自旋电子学。
picks.summary_zh: 两个量子斯格明子在阻挫自旋-1/2 磁体中束缚成分子，分子充当磁子约瑟夫森结：相对螺旋度 θ 与其间转移的磁子数 n 满足 H=E_C n²−W cosθ。在 J₁–J₂ 三角格点上 DMRG 给出 E_C 为自然尺寸（七个翻转自旋）处斯格明子能量曲率；测得的螺旋度相干定出 W≃0.02 J₁，约为斯格明子–反斯格明子隧穿劈裂之半且与各向异性无关。并排放置的两个螺旋度量子比特因而被自身相互作用强耦合。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: Two quantum skyrmions in a frustrated spin-$1/2$ magnet bind into a molecule, and the molecule acts as a magnon Josephson junction: the relative helicity $\theta$ and the number $n$ of magnons transferred between them obey $H=E_Cn^2-W\cos\theta$. DMRG on the $J_1$--$J_2$ triangular lattice gives $E_C$ as the curvature of the skyrmion energy at its natural size of seven flipped spins, and the measured helicity coherence fixes $W\simeq0.02J_1$, half the skyrmion--antiskyrmion tunnel splitting and independent of the anisotropy. Two helicity qubits side by side are thus strongly coupled by their own interaction.

picks.title: Algebraic criteria for complete relaxation in autonomous and periodically driven open quantum systems
picks.why_zh: 对有限维 GKSL 开放系统给出保证“完全弛豫”（与初态无关收敛到唯一稳态）的代数判据，并新增周期驱动情形的判据——开放系统 × 周期驱动/Floquet 主方程。
picks.summary_zh: 作者推导保证开放量子动力学完全弛豫（长期态唯一且与初态无关）的充分判据，聚焦有限维 Hilbert 空间上的 GKSL 主方程，论证只用初等数学。对自治系统复现三条已知判据，表述为 Lindblad 算子与哈密顿量的代数条件。对周期驱动系统给出新判据：类似代数条件外加时依赖 GKSL 生成元的局部连续性要求，并蕴含早先文献判据。文中亦讨论对周期调制经典主方程的含义，以及无周期性约束驱动系统的推广。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: We derive sufficient criteria that guarantee convergence of open quantum system dynamics to a unique long-time state independent of the initial conditions. We refer to this behavior as complete relaxation. Focusing on systems described by Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) master equations on finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces, our approach uses only elementary mathematical arguments. For autonomous systems, we recover three previously derived relaxation criteria, which can be expressed as algebraic conditions on the Lindblad operators and the Hamiltonian entering the GKSL equation. For periodically driven systems, we obtain a new criterion involving a similar algebraic condition and a local continuity requirement on the time-dependent GKSL generator. This result implies an earlier criterion for complete relaxation formulated in Ref. [J. Phys. A 52, 43LT01 (2019)]. We also discuss implications of our approach for periodically modulated classical master equations, as well as extensions to driven systems without a periodicity constraint.

picks.title: Quantum Simulation of Non-Markovian Open Quantum Systems via Low-Rank Kernel Compression and Coupling Dilution
picks.why_zh: 高斯环境非马尔可夫开放动力学的量子模拟：用相关核低秩压缩得到等效有限玻色浴，并引入耦合稀释以控制局域维数，给出约化态误差界与多项式线路资源——开放系统 × 量子模拟。
picks.summary_zh: 对线性耦合、零均值高斯环境，浴对约化动力学的影响完全由双时相关核决定，故可用同核等效浴替换微观环境。有限模拟区间上核的秩-N 近似给出 N 个时依赖耦合玻色模。编码到量子比特时先截断各模到最低 d 能级；强耦合导致高占据时引入耦合稀释：用多个更弱耦合副本替换单模并保持相关核，以更多模换更小局域维数。文中给出约化态误差界，并在谱衰减与耦合正则性假设下建立模拟时间与精度倒数的多项式线路宽度/深度（若基本幺正可多项式实现）。
picks.zotero_note: 本地桌面当时未在线，未做 Zotero 核对
picks.abstract: We present an error-controlled framework for the quantum simulation of non-Markovian open-system dynamics in Gaussian environments. For a system coupled linearly to a Gaussian environment with zero mean, the bath's influence on the reduced dynamics is completely determined by its two-time correlation kernel. This allows us to replace the microscopic environment with an equivalent bath that has the same kernel. On a finite simulation interval, a rank-$N$ approximation of the kernel yields an effective bath of $N$ bosonic modes with time-dependent couplings to the system. To encode these modes in qubits, we first truncate each mode to its lowest $d$ occupation levels. When stronger couplings lead to large occupations, we introduce coupling dilution, which replaces each mode with several more weakly coupled copies while preserving the bath correlation kernel. This distributes excitations across more modes and trades additional modes for smaller local dimensions. We derive explicit reduced-state error bounds and establish polynomial circuit width and depth in simulation time and inverse accuracy under stated spectral-decay and coupling-regularity assumptions, provided elementary unitaries admit polynomial-cost implementations.

picks.title: Stabilizing and detecting electron fractionalization in the Hofstadter-Hubbard model
picks.authors: Jiahao Yang · Zeyu Han · Gang v. Chen
picks.authors_full: Jiahao Yang , Zeyu Han , Gang v. Chen
picks.subjects: Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)
picks.why_zh: 三角格 Hofstadter–Hubbard 半填充：增大轨道磁通稳定并拓宽 Mott 区 U(1)₂ 手性自旋液体，电子分裂为带隙 spinon/chargon，谱函数给出可测指纹——拓扑序/分数化 × 莫尔 Chern 绝缘体动机。
picks.summary_zh: 受莫尔关联 Chern 绝缘体进展启发，作者研究半填充三角格 Hofstadter–Hubbard 模型中的电子分数化。在多种竞争非磁态中，增大轨道磁通可在 Mott 区稳定并拓宽 U(1)₂ 手性自旋液体。该区电子分裂为带隙 spinon 与带隙 chargon，有效能带与轨道磁通相连；窄 spinon 带与带隙 chargon 激发的卷积在电子谱函数与态密度中产生丰富可辨结构。结果把轨道磁通标为调控分数化细节与 Mott 转变性质的参数，并为 ARPES/STM 提供关联区本征拓扑序相对自由粒子能带拓扑的关键谱学特征。

picks.abstract: Motivated by the recent progress in correlated Chern insulator physics in moiré systems, we investigate the half-filled triangular-lattice Hofstadter--Hubbard model and its electron fractionalization. Among various competing non-magnetic states, increasing the orbital flux stabilizes and broadens the $\mathrm{U}(1)_2$ chiral spin liquid phase in the Mott regime. In this exotic regime, the electron is fractionalized into gapped spinons and gapped chargons, whose effective bands are linked to the orbital flux. The convolution of the narrow spinon bands with the gapped chargon excitations produces rich and discernible structures in the electron spectral function and the density of states. These results not only identify the orbital flux as a control parameter for the detailed patterns of electron fractionalization and the nature of the Mott transition, but also provide the key spectral characteristics for the angle-resolved photoemission and scanning tunneling studies of the relevant systems, linking the free-particle band topology to intrinsic topological order in the correlated regime.
